descriptionByLocale.en:
- Work within a dynamic trading environment alongside both Sales and Trading teams to deliver UBS products and solutions to local Institutional and Distribution clients
- Support the desk in structuring and executing client transactions, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations
- Handle client inquiries and inbound calls in a timely and professional manner
- Assist with ad-hoc projects and assignments to support business growth and desk initiatives
- Collaborate closely with teams across Taipei and Hong Kong, while providing support to the Sales Desk Head
